senses.gloss: धामकेशिन् धामकेशिन्, i. e. धामन्-केश + इन्, adj. having rays instead of hair, MBh. 3, 193.
ऽधम -धम् + अ (vb. ध्मा), latter part of comp. adj., Blowing, melting.
धाम धाम (akin to धामन्), m. [] pl. The name of a class of superhuman beings, MBh. 13, 15446.
धमनि and नी धम् + अनी̆ (vb. धमा), f. A vein, MBh. 1, 5936.
धम्मिल्ल धम्मिल्ल, m. Braided and [] ornamented hair tied round the head, Rājat. 5, 356.

धामन् धा + मन्, n.
 1. An abode, MBh. 1, 3602.
 2. State, Prab. 17, 15.
 3. A host, Chr. 292, 11, and 293, 6 = Rigv. i. 85, 11; 87, 6.
 4. Dignity, Ragh. 11, 85.
 5. Light, splendour, Prab. 26, 8.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. θέμα; A.S.-dóm, as affix of abstracts, properly ‘state.’
